name: second-brain
description: Contains legacy second-brain v1 read-only while the Git-native v2 system is being implemented. New v1 installs and legacy writes are disabled.

interface.shortDescription: Contain legacy v1 while v2 is built.
interface.longDescription: Preserves and contains the legacy Neon/MCP second-brain v1 system without deleting data. New v1 installations and remember writes are disabled; v2 remains specified but not shipped.
